Bound-text font sizing during resizing is now based on available width rather than both width and height, and editing bound text now measures its dimensions even when it is one line.

Canvas text now uses a bottom text baseline, SVG positioning no longer uses the stored baseline, and the text editor is no longer clamped to its prior maximum width; Firefox and Safari also receive a 0.5-pixel editor-width increase.
